title: Brandon Williams was out pregame testing his quad …
text:
Brandon Williams was out pregame testing his quad … Rumors News & Analysis Salaries Player Rankings NBA 2K Rankings Free Agency NBA RUMORS Brandon Williams was out pregame testing his quad …
 HoopsHype Nov. 2, 2026, 8:22 p.m. ET Anthony Slater: Brandon Williams was out pregame testing his quad contusion briefly. Just shook his head no to the Warriors training staff and went to the locker room. He’s been listed as questionable after getting banged up last night in strong 17-point performance.
